name: Creator Selfie Still
description: A creator holds the product at arm's length in phone-selfie framing, lit by a window. Good for the first frame of a hook or a plain endorsement still.
prompt: {{creator}} holding {{product}} at arm's length, phone-selfie framing, natural window light, slightly imperfect skin texture, casual room behind, {{mood}} expression, 9:16, no text
negative_prompt: studio lighting, retouched skin, text, watermark, extra hands
